claims.text: The rider did everything the platform asks of a waiting passenger: the chat log shows two messages from her inside the waiting window that are squarely locating and coordinating - 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' sent 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' sent 18:23:25 - each naming her own position and asking for the driver's. That is limb (a) of POL-NS-04, and it is on the face of the platform's own chat record, not merely the rider's assertion.

The driver never answered, and the record shows he knew he was being asked: the chat log's three messages are one system arrival notice and two rider messages, with no driver-side entry at all, and the 18:21:00 message carries a read receipt at 18:21:15 - fifteen seconds after it was sent - so the driver read the message and let the 120 second window pass unanswered. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no voice call was placed either before the trip was terminated at 18:25:30. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is therefore met on both alternatives; the driver's counter-statement that he 'waited inside the station pickup geofence until the timer ended' confirms presence and says nothing about having replied.

The rider's own track confirms she was at the pickup, not elsewhere: all 16 of her 16 qualifying fixes sit 41.9 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 200 m rider-presence radius the fee schedule sets for TRANSPORT_HUB, and her device is stationary throughout (distinct speeds 0.0 kph) from 18:20:30 to 18:25:30. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied on admissible fixes - this is not the 'undecidable and neutral' case the clause reserves for an absent rider_track.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so that clause exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'; POL-NS-04 is such a clause and it displaces the charge, which also removes POL-NS-07 from the case because that clause only operates where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and undisplaced. The sum to be returned is the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line actually charged - fare_breakdown shows total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider is presently carrying the disputed amount - and under POL-GEN-03 that is a FULL_REFUND to the rider as the filing party.

This is a case the record can decide, and the rider asks for a ruling rather than a hold: every artifact in the bundle was admitted COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so no deciding fact rests on discounted evidence and limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 are not engaged; the SGD 6.00 fee line reconciles with the fee schedule's resolution rule (TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee 6.00 and RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee 6.00 tie, so the greater is 6.00) and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged either; and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, far below the anti-farming threshold of 4 under POL-NS-07, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(b) to (e) are not met. Escalation would only hold the rider's money while the record already answers the question.

No lifetime counter may be read against this rider. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags records 1, but that is a lifetime figure and it is not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which reads 0; POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting one for the other, and POL-NS-09(d) reads only the trailing-window counter. Her rating, account age, lifetime trips and prior disputes are context only and cannot ground any finding on this trip either.

Honest concession, so the judge can narrow the issue: the rider does not press the timing arithmetic. The driver's single in-geofence run is measured at 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a 30 second surplus, so POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to refund on; and at the 18:20:20 'arrived' timestamp his fix is 24 m from the pin at 0.0 kph, so no false-arrival marker arises under POL-NS-05. The rider's case is not that the driver left too early or marked arrival from the expressway - it is that a driver who was present, stationary and 24 m away for the whole wait never once answered her.

claims.text: The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-09106 at 2026-09-06T18:20:20, which satisfies limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show test: an arrival event on the record is the first of the four conditions POL-NS-01 requires.

The gps_trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin on every one of 34 qualifying fixes (34 in-geofence, 34 qualifying), which is roughly one sixth of the 150 m arrival radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB, and the first in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 precedes the 18:20:20 arrival event; the POL-NS-02 arrival geofence is therefore satisfied and POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds.

The driver held position inside the geofence in one continuous run of 330 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 to the last at 18:25:30 — 30 seconds beyond the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01(c) sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB, and with a single recorded speed of 0 km/h throughout.

No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 18:25:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — at a moment after the required dwell had elapsed at 18:25:00, so limb (d) is satisfied in full.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the arrival event the trace shows a single distinct speed of 0 km/h (below the 15 km/h trigger) and a 24.0 m distance from the pin (far inside the 300 m limit), so the waiting clock is not recomputed and the fee is not disturbed.

No waiting-period shortfall arises to open POL-NS-06's refund route: the accumulated in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a surplus of 30 seconds, and no separate interval accumulation is needed because there was only one in-geofence run.

Compensation is payable under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 4.80, which the fare_breakdown's derived driver_compensation figure confirms; the anti-farming check does not fire because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4 threshold) and 1 divided by 120 completed trips in the same window is 0.008 (below 0.08), so no withholding and no POL-NS-09 escalation is triggered on that ground.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is not engaged: it bites only where the driver's stationary dwell is outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius, and the driver's fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB radius, so no part of the fee is diverted into a rider refund or into pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii).

The rider's answer is POL-NS-04, and the driver does not dispute the facts on which its limbs turn: the chat_log shows two rider locating messages with no driver reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) are made out, and the rider_track places the rider's device 41.9 m from the pin on 16 of 16 qualifying fixes, inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, so limb (c) is made out as well. The driver therefore rests his case on the four independently satisfied limbs of POL-NS-01 and on the POL-NS-07 payout.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is supported, and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. On the platform's own records all three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold. Limb (a): the chat log shows two messages from you inside the waiting window that are squarely locating and coordinating - 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' at 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' at 18:23:25. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply at all - the chat log's three entries are one system notice and your two messages - and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no voice call was placed either; the first message even carries a read receipt at 18:21:15, so the driver saw the request and let the 120 second window pass. Limb (c): your device sat 41.9 m from the pickup pin on 16 of 16 qualifying fixes, well inside the 200 m presence radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB and stationary throughout. This is the affirmatively-satisfied case, not the 'undecidable and neutral' case the clause reserves for an absent rider_track. POL-NS-04 is one of the clauses POL-NS-01 expressly yields to ('no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'), so it displaces the charge.

To the driver: your account that you waited inside the station geofence until the timer ended is consistent with the trace and I have accepted it. The four limbs of POL-NS-01 are indeed made out - an 'arrived' event at 18:20:20; the trace placing you 24.0 m from the pin, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius; a continuous in-geofence dwell of 330 seconds from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30 against the 300 second minimum; and termination by you at 18:25:30 on RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (0 km/h, 24 m from the pin), and there is no shortfall to open POL-NS-06 (a 30 second surplus). But POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does displace it on these facts. POL-NS-07 compensates at 80 percent only where POL-NS-01 stands undisplaced, so the payout you claimed (SGD 4.80) is not payable here, and the anti-farming check you addressed correctly does not fire either way. The fee line of SGD 6.00 reconciles with the fee schedule's resolution rule (TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee SGD 6.00 and RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee SGD 6.00 tie, so the greater is SGD 6.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

On integrity and escalation: every artifact that carries a deciding fact - the GPS trace, the trip record and the chat log - was admitted COMPLETE at weight 1.0, and the traces show no gap over 120 seconds, 34 fixes across the window and a rider track present. No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so nothing down-weights the ruling. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d read 0, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09106-01, weight 0.0) is relied on by no part of the outcome: POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not needed because there was a single continuous in-geofence run that already met the minimum. No clause produces a referral in this case, so none is issued. The disputed amount moves to you, the filing party, as a FULL_REFUND.

Both parties agree on the physical facts of this pickup, and so do I — but the record also contains a fact the driver's account leaves out, and it decides the case.

WHAT THE INSTRUMENTS SHOW. The GPS trace places the driver's vehicle 24.0 m from the Tampines MRT Exit D pin on all 34 qualifying fixes, stationary the whole time (0 km/h), in one continuous in-geofence run of 330 seconds from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30. The trip record shows no boarding and shows the driver terminating at 18:25:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. On those facts alone POL-NS-01's four conditions are met — an arrival event (18:20:20), in-geofence position at or before it, a 330-second dwell against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and a recognised termination code after the dwell elapsed — and the driver is right that POL-NS-05 finds no false marker (stationary, 24 m from the pin) and POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall (330 s against 300 s, a 30-second surplus). The driver's anti-farming point is likewise correct: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 120 completed trips, so POL-NS-07's withholding condition does not fire.

WHAT DECIDES IT. The rider was at the pickup, and the record proves it. Her own track places her device 41.9 m from the pin on all 16 qualifying fixes, inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, stationary throughout. She sent two locating messages inside the waiting window — "I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?" at 18:21:00 and "I still cannot see you. Please reply." at 18:23:25 — and the first carries a read receipt at 18:21:15, fifteen seconds after she sent it. There is no driver entry in the chat log at all, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no voice call was placed either. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 are therefore made out: (a) a locating/coordinating message, (b) no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call before termination, and (c) rider presence on admissible fixes across the waiting window.

POL-NS-01 says in terms that the fee stands only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'. POL-NS-04 is such a clause, and it displaces the charge. That also removes POL-NS-07, which operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and undisplaced; the driver's SGD 4.80 compensation therefore falls away with the fee, and I reject that part of his case for that reason. The driver's concession that he 'waited inside the station pickup geofence until the timer ended' confirms his presence and says nothing about having answered the rider — presence is not the test POL-NS-04 sets.

The remaining arithmetic is clean. The SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (6.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged; there is no clock skew over 90 seconds, no sampling gap over 120 seconds, and the chat log's three messages match trip_record.chat_message_count exactly, so POL-NS-08(a) to (c) are not engaged either. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at weight 1.0. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: my confidence is well above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict one another, neither party has any disputes-with-counterparty in the trailing 90 days, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. No profile field has been used against either party: the rider's prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for no_show_disputes_30d (which reads 0), and her rating, account age and history are context only.

RESULT. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full. No driver compensation is payable, because the clause that would have funded it is displaced. No referral is issued: POL-NS-05(ii)'s false-arrival record does not fire (qualifying in-geofence fixes exist throughout), and no other clause produces one.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the facts here are not in dispute, and the question is which clause governs them.

To the driver first, because most of what you filed is correct. EV-TRIP-09106 records an 'arrived' event at 18:20:20, and EV-GPS-09106 places your device 24.0 m from the pickup pin on every one of your 34 fixes — roughly one sixth of the 150 m arrival radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB — so POL-NS-01 limb (a) and limb (b) hold and the POL-NS-02 geofence test is satisfied. ruling.explanation:
Rider — you get the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee back, and the driver receives no compensation.

The driver's account of the baseline test is largely correct, and I accept it. POL-NS-01 is made out on its face: the trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 18:20:20 (limb a); the GPS trace puts the driver about 24 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, from 18:20:00, i.e. before that event (limb b); he held position for one continuous in-geofence run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a 30-second surplus (limb c); and there is no boarding event and the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:25:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed (limb d). I also accept the driver's POL-NS-02 (geofence), POL-NS-05 (the arrival marker was true — 24 m from the pin at 0 km/h), POL-NS-06 (no shortfall to refund) and POL-NS-03 (this is not a wrong-entrance case; his stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius) points. None of that decides the case, because POL-NS-01 chargeability is expressly 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'.

POL-NS-04 does displace it. Its three limbs are all satisfied on the platform's own records. Limb (a): the chat log shows the rider sent locating/coordinating messages inside the waiting window — 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' at 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' at 18:23:25 — each stating her position and asking for the driver's. Limb (b): there is no driver-side chat entry at all, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of either message nor placed an in-app call before terminating the trip; the first message carries a read receipt 15 seconds after it was sent, so the request was seen, not merely sent. Limb (c): all 16 of the rider's qualifying GPS fixes sit about 41.9 m from the pin, inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, and her device is stationary throughout — this is the affirmatively satisfied case, not the 'undecidable and neutral' one the clause reserves for a missing rider track. All three limbs hold, so the rider is exonerated: the fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. The driver's POL-NS-07 claim fails for that reason — POL-NS-07 only operates where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and undisplaced, and POL-NS-04 removes both the charge and the payout. The driver's own submission does not dispute the facts on which the rider's clause turns.

No escalation and no referral. The disputed line is the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee actually charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Every artifact this ruling rests on — the chat log, the trip record and the GPS trace — is admitted at weight 1.0, so nothing drags confidence down, and the fee line reconciles with the fee schedule (TRANSPORT_HUB 6.00 and RYDE_PLUS 6.00 tie; the greater is 6.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and no limb (a)–(d) impairment applies. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: both parties' trailing-window and counterparty counters read 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips). The lifetime counter rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags and the rating/account-age fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have been given no weight in either direction.
